note: Integrator registry for per-app usage attribution in scripts/scan-usage-report.mjs. The 'parties' list maps each project's on-chain payer party id(s) to its app id; this is the AUTHORITATIVE attribution signal because the payer party is real on-chain identity that cannot be forged. The operator-stamped cantonstreams.dev/app tag is only a fallback for payers not listed here, and the report FLAGS any settlement where the tag disagrees with the party registered below (see report.tagMismatches). Maintain this list so every adopter's payer party is registered, and have each adopter confirm its own party ids. Copy to config/integrators.json per reporting window. This is an EXAMPLE file — use placeholder party ids here; never commit real party fingerprints or secrets. Secrets belong in env vars / a vault, not in this JSON.
